prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a new transparent source atlas of eight CONTINUOUS CLOTHED LEGS for a small isometric Chinese historical game, for Yang Lin from Water Margin. These are technical clothing animation layers, NOT severed limbs, injuries, casualties, a story scene or a character redesign.
Input images: Image 1 is reference for the existing game's cloth colors, proportions and low brown shoes only. Images 2 and 3 are reference for brushwork and materials only; do NOT copy their detached capped knee ends or duplicate cuffs. Generate a NEW atlas, do not alter those reference files.
Composition: a square transparent atlas, TWO rows and FOUR equal columns, exactly ONE complete long leg in each cell, eight total. Top row is character's right leg, bottom row character's left leg. Column order: southeast/front-right view (toe points screen-right), southwest/front-left view (toe points screen-left), northeast/back-right view (heel visible, toes away screen-right), northwest/back-left view (heel visible, toes away screen-left). Use one consistent orthographic isometric camera, modest top-down view. Each leg is nearly straight in neutral pose, full length from the upper trouser leg hidden under the tunic down through knee, calf, ankle and ENTIRE shoe/sole. All eight have equal anatomical lengths and consistent width. Center each leg with generous completely transparent margins between cells and at canvas edges. No touching or cropped silhouettes.
Clothing continuity: warm ochre/brown loose cloth trousers narrow naturally over the knee into dark indigo/blue-gray wrapped calf bindings, then a LOW brown cloth/leather shoe with a thin tan sole. Trousers must be one uninterrupted natural cloth surface across the knee: NO circular end caps, no cut seams, no duplicated rolled knee cuff, no detached thigh, no second blue boot shaft. Knee folds are subtle and painted into the continuous cloth. The binding tapers smoothly to the ankle and overlaps the low shoe naturally, no exposed skin. Slightly worn hand-painted texture, legible dark contour, same restrained colors and lighting as references. No metal armor, ornament, modern footwear, claws, animal parts or magic.
Background: actual transparent alpha outside the eight isolated objects. Every gutter empty transparent; NO ground planes, cast shadows, halos, faint stray background pixels, texture outside the clothing, checkerboard painted into the image, text, labels, axes, borders, mannequins or reference diagrams. No torso, face, arms, weapons or extra objects.
Canon boundary: the novel's chapter44 supports a human Yang Lin and his iron tubular spear; these cloth colors and neutral leg shapes are game art implementation, not a claim that the novel prescribes this costume. Preserve the material family without adding leopard patterns to the legs.
